entries.Original: Open Choke-abo. Use /chokeabo refresh, breed, dpopup, or config.
entries.Translated: 打开 Choke-abo。使用/chokeabo 刷新、繁殖、dpopup 或 config。

entries.Original: Automation stopped.
entries.Translated: 自动化停止。

entries.Original: Training plan cleared.
entries.Translated: 训练计划已确定。

entries.Original: Scroll down to "The Dumpster Fire" channel to discuss issues / suggestions for specific plugins.
entries.Translated: 向下滚动到 “垃圾桶火灾” 频道，讨论特定插件的问题/建议。

entries.Translated: Vermaxion 拥有进阶设置和每日赛车津贴。Choke-abo 负责饲养和繁殖。

entries.Original: Permit objective: produce G9 offspring

entries.Translated: 在 VERMAXION 设置中选择你的进步目标、储备和喂养策略，然后继续开始。

entries.Original: No registered racing chocobo.
entries.Translated: 没有注册赛车巧克力棒。

entries.Original: Offspring sex is random. Two coverings do not guarantee a male and a female.
entries.Translated: 后代的性别是随机的。两层覆盖物并不能保证一个是男性还是女性。

entries.Original: Pedigree / sex

entries.Original: No breeding forms or covering proof in inventory.
entries.Translated: 库存中无繁育表格或保护证明。

entries.Original: Clean up G1-G8 stock
entries.Translated: 清理 G1-G8 库存

entries.Original: Discard is permanent. G9 stock, covering proof and selected breeding inputs are protected.
entries.Translated: 弃用是永久性的。G9 品种、覆盖证明和选定的育种投入均受到保护。

entries.Original: Purchased covering permissions

entries.Original: Discard selected stock

entries.Original: No chocobo data loaded yet.

entries.Original: Choose the number of training sessions and feed grade for each stat.
entries.Translated: 选择每项数据的训练课程数量和进食等级。

entries.Original: Exact shopping list for the current plan.
entries.Translated: 目前计划的精确购物清单。

entries.Original: Load racing chocobo data first so the purchase plan can compare against sessions available.
entries.Translated: 首先加载赛车巧克力数据，这样购买计划就可以与现有会话进行比较。

entries.Original: No planned feed purchases.
entries.Translated: 没有计划的饲料购买。

entries.Original: Current currency is below the planned purchase total. Adjust the plan or stock up before the buy loop is enabled.
entries.Translated: 当前货币低于计划购买总额。调整计划或在启动购买循环之前增加库存。

entries.Original: Feed Planned Sessions
entries.Translated: 提供计划会话

entries.Original: Start / Resume Breeding
entries.Translated: 开始/恢复繁育

entries.Original: Automation uses the session-capped plan and subtracts feed already on hand before buying.
entries.Translated: 自动化使用会话上限计划，并在购买前减去已有的订阅量。

entries.Translated: 印地语 UI 字体不可用。请使用英语继续。

entries.Translated: 主窗口中可见的语言

entries.Translated: 注意力不集中时自动淡出

entries.Translated: 非聚焦延迟 (秒)

entries.Translated: 目标周期在安全边界处暂停。

entries.Original: Stock cleanup is active; stop it before starting breeding.
entries.Translated: 库存清理正在进行;在开始繁育之前停止。

entries.Original: Log into a character before starting breeding automation.
entries.Translated: 在开始生殖自动化之前登录角色。

entries.Original: This target cycle is owned by VERMAXION; use its Target Pedigree controls.
entries.Translated: 这个目标循环归 VERMAXION 所有;使用其 Target Pedigree 控制。

entries.Original: Target inputs changed while an immediate feed action was awaiting evidence.
entries.Translated: 目标输入发生变化时，即时馈入行动正在等待证据。

entries.Original: Another Choke-abo automation owns the feed/vendor services.
entries.Translated: 另一个 Choke Abo 自动化拥有 feed/vendor 服务。

entries.Original: Loading current racer data before selecting a breeding action.
entries.Translated: 在选择育种行动之前加载当前赛车手数据。

entries.Original: Initial racing tutorial admitted; VERMAXION owns the race.
entries.Translated: 最初的赛车教程已获承认;Vermaxion 拥有这场比赛。

entries.Original: Complete Like Sire Like Fledgling before retiring this racer.
entries.Translated: 在这位赛车手退役之前，完成像父亲一样的事情。

entries.Original: An unowned Proof of Covering is present; its exact start time cannot be inferred safely.
entries.Translated: 存在一个未知的覆盖证明;无法安全地推断其确切开始时间。

entries.Original: The selected target feed item could not be resolved.
entries.Translated: 选定的目标馈送项无法解析。

entries.Original: Persisted feed-purchase intent has no item baseline.
entries.Translated: 持续的订阅购买意图没有商品基准。

entries.Original: Feed purchase completed without an exact item-ID quantity increase.
entries.Translated: 饲料采购已完成，未增加确切的商品 ID 数量。

entries.Original: Feed selection changed after purchase; exact purchase evidence cannot be reconciled.
entries.Translated: 饲料选择在购买后发生了变化;确切的购买证据无法调和。

entries.Original: Purchased feed could not be resolved to an exact inventory slot.
entries.Translated: 购买的饲料无法解析为确切的库存槽。

entries.Original: Reload found an unverified feed-purchase intent; it will not be replayed.
entries.Translated: 重新加载发现未经验证的订阅购买意图;不会重放。

entries.Original: The completed feed batch does not contain the current training selection.
entries.Translated: 完成的饲料批次不包含当前的训练选择。

entries.Original: The feed batch is not fully present in inventory; reconcile its pending purchases before another vendor visit.
entries.Translated: 饲料批次尚未完全进入库存;在另一家供应商到访之前协调其待处理的采购。

entries.Original: Persisted feeding intent has no item baseline.
entries.Translated: 持续进食意图没有项目基线。

entries.Original: Feeding did not produce one exact feed-item decrease and one confirmed-session decrease.
entries.Translated: 喂食没有导致一个精确的饲料项目减少和一个确认的会话减少。

entries.Original: Reload found an unverified feeding intent; it will not be replayed.
entries.Translated: 重新装填发现未经证实的喂食意图;不会重放。

entries.Original: Could not reach the required breeding service for native UI inspection.
entries.Translated: 未能达到原生 UI 检查所需的繁育服务。

entries.Original: Breeding supply is purchased, but the supplier interaction did not release; Resume to reconcile the retained item.
entries.Translated: 繁育供应已购买，但供应商交互未解除;继续协调保留项目。

entries.Original: Covering Commence was dispatched; its exact confirmation or proof result must be reconciled before another covering.
entries.Translated: 报道开始已经发布;其准确确认或证实结果必须在进行下一次报道之前达成一致。

entries.Original: The retained covering parent changed before native selection.
entries.Translated: 保留覆盖父体在原生选择之前发生了变化。

entries.Original: The selected covering stock is captured; native selected-parent evidence and the fee require verification before Commence.
entries.Translated: 选定的覆盖股票被捕获;原生选定的父母证据和费用需要在开始之前进行验证。

entries.Original: Native racing unlock verified; reassessing feeding and racing.
entries.Translated: 原生赛车解锁验证;重新评估喂食和赛车。

entries.Original: The initial racing tutorial awaits the next daily allowance.
entries.Translated: 最初的赛车教程正在等待下一次每日津贴。

entries.Original: Registrar race entry captured; initial training admission is awaiting verification.
entries.Translated: 登记比赛入场记录已捕获;初始训练入场记录正在等待确认。

entries.Original: Retirement confirmation sent; awaiting the retired form and cleared current racer. Any further native prompt is captured before another action.
entries.Translated: 退役确认已发送;等待退役状态并清除当前赛车手。任何进一步的本地提示都会在下一次行动之前被捕捉。

entries.Original: Retirement requires an intermediate rank40 racer and room for its retained form.
entries.Translated: 退役需要一名 40 级中级赛车手和保留形式的空间。

entries.Original: The observed retirement confirmation button is unavailable.
entries.Translated: 观察到的退休确认按钮不可用。

entries.Original: Retirement menu selected; the resulting native window is captured before confirming retirement.
entries.Translated: 选择退休菜单;在确认退休前捕获生成的原生窗口。

entries.Original: Registration confirmation was sent but matching form consumption and current racer evidence are unavailable.
entries.Translated: 注册确认已发送，但无法获得匹配的表格使用和当前赛车手证据。

entries.Original: Selected registration form; the resulting registration window is captured for verification.
entries.Translated: 选择注册表单;捕获生成的注册窗口进行验证。

entries.Original: The selected registration form changed before opening its context menu.
entries.Translated: 在打开其上下文菜单之前，所选注册表单已更改。

entries.Original: The native Select Chocobo list entry is unavailable or disabled.
entries.Translated: 原生 Select Chocobo 列表条目不可用或已禁用。

entries.Original: Breeding service interaction captured; its native selection must be verified before dispatch.
entries.Translated: 繁育服务交互被捕获;其原生选择必须在派遣前进行验证。

entries.Original: Saved collection evidence is invalid; no collection will be replayed.
entries.Translated: 保存的收集证据无效;不会重放任何收集。

entries.Original: Collection occurred, but the exact new offspring and its trait must be reconciled before counting or another covering.
entries.Translated: 采集确实发生了，但在计数或进行其他覆盖之前，必须确定确切的新后代及其特征。

entries.Original: Collection was requested; proof consumption and one matching fledgling must be reconciled before another request.
entries.Translated: 收集请求已提出;证据消耗和一只匹配的雏鸟必须在另一个请求之前达成协议。

entries.Original: Collection requires the existing eligible covering, its retained-parent pedigree and exactly one Proof of Covering.
entries.Translated: 收集需要现有的合格覆盖、其保留父系血统以及确切的覆盖证明。

entries.Original: The required supply does not match the selected breeding mode and supplier.
entries.Translated: 所需供应量与所选育种模式和供应商不匹配。

entries.Original: A free main-inventory slot is required for the breeding supply.
entries.Translated: 育种供应需要一个免费的主库存槽。

entries.Original: The required breeding supply was not found in the verified native shop.
entries.Translated: 所需的繁育用品未在经认证的本地商店中找到。

entries.Original: A required-supply purchase is unverified after reload; its matching pending confirmation or inventory result is required before another purchase.
entries.Translated: 重新加载后，所需物资的购买将未经验证;在进行下一次购买之前，需要与其匹配的待确认物品或库存结果进行验证。

entries.Original: Cannot skip feeding without a current racer snapshot.
entries.Translated: 如果没有当前赛车手的快照，就无法跳过喂食。

entries.Original: Covering wait has no valid eligibility evidence.
entries.Translated: 覆盖等待没有有效的资格证据。

entries.Original: Covering is eligible; adoption is awaiting exact capture evidence.
entries.Translated: 报道符合条件;采用正在等待确切的捕获证据。

entries.Original: Breeding must be settled and G9 reached.
entries.Translated: 繁育问题必须解决，G9 已经达成。

entries.Original: Breeding, character or stock changed; cleanup stopped.
entries.Translated: 繁育、特征或品种发生变化;清理工作停止。

entries.Original: Review the selected stock before discarding.
entries.Translated: 在放弃之前，请检查所选股票。

entries.Original: No eligible stock.
entries.Translated: 没有合格股票。

entries.Original: Waiting for discard result...
entries.Translated: 等待丢弃结果......

entries.Original: Cleanup cancelled.
entries.Translated: 清理取消。

entries.Original: Stock cleanup completed.
entries.Translated: 库存清理完成。

entries.Original: Breeding UI mappings still require native inspection before automatic selection is available.
entries.Translated: 繁育 UI 映射在自动选择可用之前，仍需要进行原生检查。

entries.Original: Complete the registrar's initial racing training course.
entries.Translated: 完成注册员的初步赛车培训课程。

entries.Original: Covering is eligible; collection requires a verified native UI mapping.
entries.Translated: 覆盖符合条件;集合需要经过验证的原生 UI 映射。

entries.Original: The covering confirmation would cross the gil reserve. Explicit Resume is required.
entries.Translated: 覆盖确认将超出预算范围。需要明确重新申请。

entries.Original: The required covering fee would cross the gil reserve. Explicit Resume is required.
entries.Translated: 所需的覆盖费将超过基尔预算。需要明确履职。

entries.Original: Feed for the available training sessions cannot be purchased within the currency reserves.
entries.Translated: 可用的培训课程的饲料不能在货币储备中购买。

entries.Original: No free main-inventory slot is available for target feed.
entries.Translated: 没有免费的主库存槽可用于目标馈送。

entries.Original: Paused by VERMAXION at a safe boundary.

entries.Translated: 等待赛车巧克力数据......

entries.Original: Use Refresh Chocobo Data or /chokeabo refresh to load racing chocobo stats.
entries.Translated: 使用 Refresh Chocobo Data 或/chokeabo 刷新来加载赛车 Chocobo 统计数据。

entries.Original: The /goldsaucer command was not accepted.
entries.Translated: /goldsacer 命令未被接受。

entries.Original: Gold Saucer Info ready; waiting before Chocobo tab callback.
entries.Translated: 金碟信息准备就绪;等待 Chocobo 标签回复。

entries.Original: Gold Saucer window did not appear in time.
entries.Translated: 金碟窗口没有及时出现。

entries.Original: The observed Chocobo tab is not ready for its native button event.
entries.Translated: 观察到的 Chocobo 标签还没有为其原生按钮事件做好准备。

entries.Original: Racing chocobo page detected; waiting for RaceChocoboManager data.
entries.Translated: 检测到 RaceChocobo 页面;正在等待 RaceChocoboManager 数据。

entries.Original: RaceChocoboManager did not load within 30 seconds after selecting the native Chocobo tab.
entries.Translated: RaceChocoboManager 在选择原生 Chocobo 选项卡后的 30 秒内未加载。

entries.Translated: 投影

entries.Translated: 前往巧克力广场......

entries.Translated: 转向赛车巧克力棒教练......

entries.Original: Opening Race Chocobo Trainer...
entries.Translated: 开幕赛巧可宝教练......

entries.Original: Waiting for feed inventory...
entries.Translated: 等待饲料库存......

entries.Original: Finding feed...
entries.Translated: 搜索 feed...

entries.Original: Opening inventory context menu...
entries.Translated: 打开库存上下文菜单......

entries.Original: Waiting for Feed context menu...
entries.Translated: 等待 Feed 上下文菜单......

entries.Original: Selecting Feed...
entries.Translated: 选择订阅源......

entries.Original: Waiting for Commence...
entries.Translated: 等待开始......

entries.Original: Confirming training...
entries.Translated: 确认训练......

entries.Original: Waiting for training to complete...
entries.Translated: 等待训练完成......

entries.Original: Feed cycle complete.
entries.Translated: 馈送周期完成。

entries.Original: Feed cycle failed.
entries.Translated: 馈送周期失败。

entries.Original: Could not start Lifestream travel to Chocobo Square.
entries.Translated: 无法启动前往 Chocobo 广场的 Lifestream 旅行。

entries.Original: Timed out waiting to arrive in Chocobo Square.
entries.Translated: 等待到达 Chocobo 广场的时间已经过去了。

entries.Original: Could not find Race Chocobo Trainer in Chocobo Square.
entries.Translated: 在巧克力广场找不到赛车巧克力教练。

entries.Original: Could not path near Race Chocobo Trainer. Move closer or check vnavmesh.
entries.Translated: 无法靠近赛车巧克力棒教练。靠近点或查看 vnavmesh。

entries.Original: Timed out moving near Race Chocobo Trainer.
entries.Translated: 计划在赛车巧可宝教练附近移动。

entries.Original: Could not open Race Chocobo Trainer. Move closer and try again.
entries.Translated: 无法打开 Race Chocobo Trainer。靠近再试一次。

entries.Original: Trainer feed inventory did not open after selecting the trainer menu entry.
entries.Translated: 选择培训师菜单条目后，培训师饲料清单未打开。

entries.Original: No visible inventory window was found while opening the trainer-feed context menu.
entries.Translated: 打开培训师提供的上下文菜单时，未发现可见的清单窗口。

entries.Original: Inventory window disappeared before the trainer-feed context menu became visible.
entries.Translated: 库存窗口在培训师提供的上下文菜单变得可见之前就消失了。

entries.Original: Context menu disappeared before Feed could be selected.
entries.Translated: 上下文菜单在选择 Feed 之前就消失了。

entries.Original: Commence window did not appear after selecting Feed.
entries.Translated: 选择 “Feed” 后，开始窗口未显示。

entries.Original: Training confirmation window did not appear after Commence.
entries.Translated: 训练确认窗口在开始后没有出现。

entries.Original: Invalid offspring production settings.
entries.Translated: 无效后代生产设置。

entries.Original: Reconcile the existing covering before producing another offspring.
entries.Translated: 在产下新的后代之前，调和现有的覆盖物。

entries.Original: Offspring production requires G9 breeding stock; lower-generation racing is stopped.
entries.Translated: 后代生产需要 G9 育种库存;下一代的竞争已经停止。

entries.Original: The registered G9 racer does not have a confirmed requested trait. Retain it and select suitable breeding stock.
entries.Translated: 注册的 G9 赛车手尚未确认所要求的特征。请保留它并选择合适的育种品种。

entries.Original: Cover matching G9 stock with its retained opposite-sex G9 parent.
entries.Translated: 包括 G9 股票与保留的异性父母 G9 股票的匹配。

entries.Original: No usable retired G9 parent has a confirmed requested trait. Retain offspring and replenish suitable G9 stock.
entries.Translated: 没有可用的退休 G9 亲本具有已确认的所需特征。保留后代并补充合适的 G9 库存。

entries.Original: Raise this non-matching G9 offspring as the missing owned counterpart; retain matching outputs.
entries.Translated: 将这个不匹配的 G9 后代培育成缺失的拥有对应物;保留匹配的输出。

entries.Original: Missing a usable opposite-sex G9 parent. Owned mode requires suitable G9 stock or an explicit switch to NPC permits.

resources.Key: Missing an owned G{0} counterpart. No owned pair can produce G{1} or higher; select a permitted covering explicitly. Lower-generation rebuilding is stopped.
resources.Original: Falta pareja propia G{0}. Ninguna pareja produce G{1}+; elige explícitamente un cruce con permiso. Reconstrucción inferior detenida.
resources.Translated: 缺少自身配对 G{0}。没有配对产生 G{1}+;明确选择一个经许可的交叉。下部重建暂停。

resources.Key: Missing a usable opposite-sex G9 parent. Owned mode requires suitable G9 stock or an explicit switch to NPC permits.
resources.Original: Falta progenitor G9 útil del sexo opuesto. El modo propio requiere ejemplares G9 o cambiar explícitamente a permisos NPC.
resources.Translated: 缺少有用的异性亲代 G9。专属模式需要 G9 样本，或明确更改为 NPC 许可。

resources.Key: Timed out moving near Race Chocobo Trainer.
resources.Original: Tiempo agotado al acercarse a Race Chocobo Trainer.
resources.Translated: 在接近 Chocobo 教练的比赛中耗尽时间。

resources.Key: The current racer exceeds the selected target pedigree; retain it.
resources.Original: El corredor supera el linaje objetivo; reténlo.
resources.Translated: 跑者超越了目标线;坚持住。

resources.Key: The selected covering stock is captured; native selected-parent evidence and the fee require verification before Commence.
resources.Original: Ejemplares capturados; verifica padres nativos y coste antes de comenzar.
resources.Translated: 捕获的样本;在开始之前检查原生父母和成本。

resources.Key: No retained parent can produce G{0} or higher; lower-generation covering is stopped.
resources.Original: Ningún progenitor retenido produce G{0} o superior; cruces inferiores detenidos.
resources.Translated: 没有被保留的亲本产生 G{0}或更高;较低的交叉被阻止。

resources.Key: The active G{0} racer is above target G{1}.
resources.Original: El corredor activo G{0} supera el objetivo G{1}.
resources.Translated: 活跃跑者 G{0}超越目标 G{1}。

resources.Original: Exportar el registro lleno de todos modos
resources.Translated: 以任何方式导出完整日志

resources.Key: Pause Content ID does not match the current character.
resources.Original: El Content ID de pausa no coincide con el personaje actual.
resources.Translated: 暂停内容 ID 与当前角色不匹配。

resources.Key: Pass {0}: waiting to verify caps in {1:0.0}s. {2}
Current racer data could not be loaded: {0}
resources.Original: No se pudieron cargar datos del corredor: {0}

resources.Key: Race the useful G{0} {1} candidate to rank {2}.
resources.Original: Haz correr al candidato útil G{0} {1} hasta rango {2}.
resources.Translated: 将有用候选人 G{0}{1}移动到范围{2}。

resources.Key: No usable retired G9 parent has a confirmed requested trait. Retain offspring and replenish suitable G9 stock.
resources.Original: No hay progenitor G9 retirado útil con rasgo confirmado. Retén crías y repón ejemplares G9.
resources.Translated: 没有已确认特征的有用 G9 亲本被移除。请保留幼崽并补充 G9 样本。

resources.Key: No breeding forms or covering proof in inventory.
resources.Original: No hay formularios de cría ni comprobantes de cruce en el inventario.
resources.Translated: 库存中没有繁育表格或杂交验收单。

resources.Key: Cleanup complete: no planned training remains.
resources.Original: Limpieza completa: no quedan sesiones previstas.
resources.Translated: 彻底清理：不再安排会议。

resources.Key: Feed the target racer before declaring it ready.
resources.Original: Alimenta al corredor objetivo antes de declararlo listo.
resources.Translated: 在宣布目标跑者准备就绪之前，先为其提供能量。
传输 {0}:喂食 (剩余 {1} 会话)。

resources.Key: Reload found an unverified feed-purchase intent; it will not be replayed.
resources.Original: Recarga: intención de compra sin verificar; no se repetirá.
resources.Translated: 重新订购：未经确认的购买意图;不会再次出现。

resources.Key: Target inputs changed while an immediate feed action was awaiting evidence.
resources.Original: Las entradas objetivo cambiaron mientras una alimentación inmediata esperaba pruebas.
resources.Translated: 目标输入发生变化时，即时进食正在等待测试。

resources.Key: The required breeding supply would cross the {0} reserve.
resources.Original: El suministro de cría reduciría la reserva de {0}.
resources.Translated: 繁殖供应将减少{0}的储备。

resources.Key: Covering is eligible; collection requires a verified native UI mapping.
resources.Original: Cruce listo; recogida requiere un mapeo nativo verificado.
resources.Translated: 交叉路口准备就绪;需要验证当地地图。
为计划的会话提供动力
移动到 Tack & Feed 交易员......

resources.Key: Covering Commence was dispatched; its exact confirmation or proof result must be reconciled before another covering.
resources.Original: Cruce iniciado; reconcilia su confirmación exacta o comprobante antes de otro.
resources.Translated: 交叉开始;在另一次交叉之前协调您的准确确认或验证。

resources.Key: The covering confirmation would cross the gil reserve. Explicit Resume is required.
resources.Original: Confirmar el cruce reduciría la reserva de guiles. Requiere Reanudar explícitamente.
resources.Translated: 确认交叉将减少 Gyle 储备。需要明确重新连接。

resources.Key: Trainer feed flow stayed unstable after {0} recovery attempts. Last issue: {1}
resources.Original: Alimentación inestable tras {0} recuperaciones. Último problema: {1}
resources.Translated: {0}恢复后电源不稳定。最新问题:{1}

resources.Key: Buying {0} for {1} {2} within reserves; awaiting its inventory result.
resources.Original: Comprando {0} por {1} {2} dentro de las reservas; esperando inventario.
resources.Translated: 在预订中以{1} {2}的价格购买{0};等待库存。

resources.Key: Could not reach the required breeding service for native UI inspection.
resources.Original: No se pudo alcanzar el servicio de cría para inspección nativa.
resources.Translated: 未能联系到繁育服务部门进行本地检查。

resources.Key: Retirement confirmation sent; awaiting the retired form and cleared current racer. Any further native prompt is captured before another action.
resources.Original: Retiro confirmado; esperando formulario y corredor retirado. Se captura cualquier aviso antes de otra acción.
resources.Translated: 确认退出;等待表格和经纪人退出。在采取进一步行动之前，将捕捉任何警告。

resources.Key: Finish the existing covering with its saved goal before changing the production target.
resources.Original: Termina el cruce con su objetivo guardado antes de cambiar la producción.
resources.Translated: 在更改生产之前，完成与保存目标的交叉。

resources.Key: Cleanup did not start: load racing chocobo data first.
resources.Original: Limpieza no iniciada: carga primero los datos del corredor.
resources.Translated: 未开始的清理：先加载走廊数据。

resources.Key: A required-supply purchase is unverified after reload; its matching pending confirmation or inventory result is required before another purchase.
resources.Original: Compra sin verificar tras recarga; requiere confirmación pendiente coincidente o resultado de inventario antes de otra.
resources.Translated: 购买时不需要在充电后核实;需要在下一次购买之前同时进行待确认或库存结果确认。

resources.Key: Could not path near Race Chocobo Trainer. Move closer or check vnavmesh.
resources.Original: No hay ruta a Race Chocobo Trainer. Acércate o revisa vnavmesh.
resources.Translated: 没有前往 Race Chocobo Trainer 的路线。请靠近或查看 vnavmesh。

resources.Key: vnavmesh is unavailable or not ready for target feeding.
resources.Original: vnavmesh no está disponible o listo para alimentar.

resources.Translated: 这个循环中预期的会话:{0}

resources.Key: Covering is eligible; adoption is awaiting exact capture evidence.
resources.Original: Cruce listo; adopción espera pruebas exactas capturadas.
resources.Translated: 交叉路口准备就绪;采用等待捕获的准确证据。

resources.Key: Could not locate {0} in the main inventory pages.
resources.Original: No se encontró {0} en el inventario principal.

resources.Key: Context menu disappeared before Feed could be selected.
resources.Original: El menú desapareció antes de seleccionar Alimentar.
resources.Translated: 菜单在选择 “进食” 之前就会消失。

resources.Key: Reconcile the existing Proof of Covering before another covering.
resources.Original: Reconcilia el comprobante existente antes de otro cruce.
resources.Translated: 在另一个交叉点之前调和现有证书。

resources.Key: Current racer data has not been loaded.
resources.Original: No se han cargado datos del corredor actual.
resources.Translated: 当前走廊数据尚未加载。

resources.Key: No free main-inventory slot is available for target feed.
resources.Original: No hay espacio libre en el inventario principal para el alimento objetivo.
resources.Translated: 目标食物在主库存中没有可用空间。

resources.Key: Timed out waiting to arrive in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Tiempo de llegada a Chocobo Square agotado.
resources.Translated: 抵达巧克力广场的时间已经用完。

resources.Key: Required Lifestream/vnavmesh vendor interaction is unavailable.
resources.Original: Interacción Lifestream/vnavmesh del vendedor no disponible.
resources.Translated: 供应商的 Lifestream/vnavmesh 交互不可用。

resources.Key: Feed selection changed after purchase; exact purchase evidence cannot be reconciled.
resources.Original: Selección cambiada tras la compra; no se pueden reconciliar las pruebas exactas.
resources.Translated: 购买后选择发生变化;无法调和准确的测试结果。

resources.Key: Saved collection evidence is invalid; no collection will be replayed.
resources.Original: Pruebas de recogida inválidas; no se repetirá.
resources.Translated: 无效收集试验;不会再次发生。

resources.Original: Objetivo de permisos: avanzar el linaje

resources.Key: The completed feed batch does not contain the current training selection.
resources.Original: El lote completo no contiene la selección de entrenamiento actual.
resources.Translated: 完整批次不包含当前的训练选择。

resources.Original: Abrir herramientas de registro de XA Slave
resources.Translated: 打开 XA Slave 注册工具

resources.Key: Log into a character to see chocobo progression.
resources.Original: Entra con un personaje para ver el progreso del chocobo.
resources.Translated: 他带着一个角色进入，观察巧克力棒的进展。

resources.Key: Retirement menu selected; the resulting native window is captured before confirming retirement.
resources.Original: Menú de retiro seleccionado; ventana resultante capturada antes de confirmar.
resources.Translated: 选择的退出菜单;在确认之前捕获的结果窗口。
复制/压缩 Dalamaud 的记录

resources.Key: The selected target feed item could not be resolved.
resources.Original: No se pudo identificar el alimento objetivo.
Ajustes de producción de crías inválidos.

resources.Key: Could not open Race Chocobo Trainer. Move closer and try again.
resources.Original: No se pudo abrir Race Chocobo Trainer. Acércate y reintenta.
resources.Translated: 无法打开 Race Chocobo Trainer。靠近再试一次。

resources.Key: Current currency is below the planned purchase total. Adjust the plan or stock up before the buy loop is enabled.
resources.Original: La moneda disponible no cubre las compras. Ajusta el plan o reúne fondos antes de activar el ciclo.
resources.Translated: 可用货币不支付购买费用。在触发循环之前，请设置计划或筹集资金。

resources.Original: Mostrar el modo compacto en la ventana principal
resources.Translated: 在主窗口中显示紧凑模式

resources.Key: VERMAXION owns progression settings and the daily racing allowance. Choke-abo carries out feeding and breeding.
resources.Original: VERMAXION gestiona el progreso y las carreras diarias permitidas. Choke-abo alimenta y cría.
resources.Translated: Vermaxion 负责管理进度和允许的日常跑步。Choke-abo 负责喂养和饲养。

resources.Key: Registration confirmation was sent but matching form consumption and current racer evidence are unavailable.
resources.Original: Registro confirmado pero faltan pruebas de consumo del formulario y corredor actual.
resources.Translated: 已确认登记，但缺少当前表格和经纪人的使用证明。

resources.Key: Opens XA Slave's Utility > XA Mods panel, which contains Dalamud Log Cleaner.
resources.Original: Abre el panel Utility > XA Mods de XA Slave, que contiene Dalamud Log Cleaner.
resources.Translated: 打开 XA Slave 的 “实用工具”>“XA 模式” 面板，其中包含 Damud Log Cleaner。

resources.Key: The active G{0} racer is target-ready.
resources.Original: El corredor activo G{0} está listo para el objetivo.
resources.Translated: 活跃跑者 G{0}已经准备好迎接目标。

resources.Key: Feed did not appear to consume {0}. Check the trainer flow and inventory state.
resources.Original: No parece haberse consumido {0}. Revisa el entrenador y el inventario.
resources.Translated: 看起来没有消耗{0}。检查教练和库存。

resources.Key: Buying {0} feed across {1} items for {2} available training sessions.
resources.Original: Comprando {0} alimentos de {1} artículos para {2} sesiones disponibles.
resources.Translated: 从 {1} 商品中购买 {0} 食物，以获得 {2} 可用会话。

resources.Key: Choose the number of training sessions and feed grade for each stat.
resources.Original: Elige las sesiones y el grado de alimento para cada atributo.
resources.Translated: 为每个属性选择疗程和食物等级。

resources.Key: Register the exact useful G{0} {1} fledgling.
resources.Original: Registra la cría útil G{0} {1} exacta.
resources.Translated: 记录准确的有用繁殖 G{0} {1}。

resources.Original: No hay compras de alimento previstas.

resources.Key: Pass {0}: Chocobo stat refresh failed; retrying refresh in {1:0.0}s. {2}
resources.Translated: 过去 {0}:更新失败;在 {1:0.0}s 中重试。 {2}

resources.Key: G{0} is missing a usable opposite-sex parent and no preceding-pedigree pair can produce it.
resources.Original: Falta progenitor G{0} útil del sexo opuesto y ninguna pareja anterior puede producirlo.
resources.Translated: 缺少有用的异性亲本 G{0}，而且之前的任何一对都无法产生它。

resources.Key: Permit objective: produce a missing current-pedigree counterpart
resources.Original: Objetivo de permisos: producir la pareja que falta del linaje actual
resources.Translated: 许可目标：创造当前血脉中缺失的伴侣

resources.Key: Loading current racer data before selecting a breeding action.
resources.Original: Cargando datos del corredor antes de elegir la acción de cría.
resources.Translated: 在选择繁殖行动之前加载走廊数据。

resources.Key: This progression requires V3; older callers cannot remove its spending limits.
resources.Original: Este progreso requiere V3; los clientes antiguos no pueden eliminar límites de gasto.
resources.Translated: 这种进步需要 V3;传统客户无法消除支出限制。

resources.Key: Selected registration form; the resulting registration window is captured for verification.
resources.Original: Formulario seleccionado; ventana resultante capturada para verificación.
resources.Translated: 选择表单;捕获结果窗口以进行验证。

resources.Key: Timed out moving near Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Original: Tiempo agotado al acercarse a Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Translated: 接近 Tack & Feed Trader 时耗尽时间。

resources.Key: Feed for the available training sessions cannot be purchased within the currency reserves.
resources.Original: No se puede comprar alimento para las sesiones sin reducir las reservas.
resources.Translated: 如果不减少储备，就无法购买会议用食物。

resources.Key: No useful active racer, fledgling, or covering parents are available.
resources.Original: No hay corredor, cría ni padres útiles disponibles.
resources.Translated: 没有走廊，没有孩子，也没有有用的父母可用。

resources.Key: G{0} has already been reached; the target cannot move backwards.
resources.Original: Ya se alcanzó G{0}; el objetivo no puede retroceder.
resources.Translated: G{0}已经到达，目标无法撤退。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer Info ready; waiting before Chocobo tab callback...
resources.Original: Información de Gold Saucer lista; esperando llamada a pestaña chocobo...
resources.Translated: Gold Saucer 信息列表;等待 Chocobo 标签的呼叫......

resources.Key: Feeding did not produce one exact feed-item decrease and one confirmed-session decrease.
resources.Original: La alimentación no redujo exactamente un alimento y una sesión confirmada.
resources.Translated: 饮食并没有完全减少一种食物和一个确认的疗程。

resources.Key: The required supply does not match the selected breeding mode and supplier.
resources.Original: El suministro no coincide con modo de cría y proveedor elegidos.
resources.Translated: 供应与选择的饲养方式和供应商不符。

resources.Key: A free main-inventory slot is required for the breeding supply.
resources.Original: Se requiere espacio libre en inventario principal para el suministro.
resources.Translated: 主库存中需要腾出空间用于供应。

resources.Key: Could not open Tack & Feed Trader. Move closer and try again.
resources.Original: No se pudo abrir Tack & Feed Trader. Acércate y reintenta.
resources.Translated: 无法打开 Tack & Feed Trader。靠近并再试一次。

resources.Key: Ready to plan the next action
resources.Original: Listo para planificar la siguiente acción
resources.Translated: 准备好规划下一步行动

resources.Key: Collection occurred, but the exact new offspring and its trait must be reconciled before counting or another covering.
resources.Original: Recogida realizada; reconcilia la cría exacta y su rasgo antes de contar o cruzar.
resources.Translated: 已完成收集;在计数或交配之前，将准确的幼崽与其特征进行协调。

resources.Key: Cannot skip feeding without a current racer snapshot.
resources.Original: No se puede omitir sin datos actuales del corredor.
resources.Translated: 如果没有走廊的最新数据，就不能省略。

resources.Key: The desired inherited ability is unavailable in current game data.
resources.Original: La habilidad heredada deseada no está en los datos actuales.
resources.Translated: 目前数据中没有所需的遗传技能。

resources.Key: The native Select Chocobo list entry is unavailable or disabled.
resources.Original: La opción nativa Select Chocobo no está disponible o está desactivada.
resources.Translated: 原生 Select Chocobo 选项不可用或处于关闭状态。

resources.Key: Produced {0}/{1} matching G9 offspring; retained unregistered.
resources.Original: Producidas {0}/{1} crías G9 coincidentes; retenidas sin registrar.
resources.Translated: 生产了{0}/{1}匹配的 G9 后代;保留未登记。

resources.Key: Scroll down to "The Dumpster Fire" channel to discuss issues / suggestions for specific plugins.
resources.Original: Visita el canal «The Dumpster Fire» para problemas y sugerencias de plugins.
resources.Translated: 请访问 “The Dumpster Fire” 频道，了解插件问题和建议。

resources.Key: Exact shopping list for the current plan.
resources.Original: Lista exacta de compras del plan actual.
resources.Translated: 当前计划的准确购物清单。

resources.Key: The observed Chocobo tab is not ready for its native button event.
resources.Original: La pestaña chocobo observada no está lista para su evento nativo.
resources.Translated: 观察到的 Chocobo 标签尚未准备好处理其原生事件。

resources.Key: Reserve stable and vendor automation seams.
resources.Original: Preparar interfaces de automatización de establo y vendedor.
resources.Translated: 准备谷仓和卖家自动化界面。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer window did not appear in time.
resources.Original: La ventana Gold Saucer no apareció a tiempo.
resources.Translated: 金碟窗口没有及时显示。

resources.Key: The observed retirement confirmation button is unavailable.
resources.Original: El botón de confirmación de retiro observado no está disponible.
resources.Translated: 观察到的退出确认按钮不可用。

resources.Key: Pass {0}: buying missing feed ({1} sessions remain).
resources.Translated: 过去 {0}:购买缺少的食物 (剩余 {1} 会话)

resources.Key: Initial racing tutorial admitted; VERMAXION owns the race.
resources.Original: Tutorial inicial admitido; VERMAXION controla la carrera.
resources.Translated: 初始教程获得认可;Vermaxion 控制比赛。

resources.Key: The native gil-shop purchase could not be dispatched safely.
resources.Original: No se pudo ejecutar de forma segura la compra nativa con guiles.
resources.Translated: 无法安全地使用 guiles 进行原生购买。

resources.Key: Trainer feed inventory did not open after selecting the trainer menu entry.
resources.Original: El inventario de alimento no se abrió tras seleccionar el menú del entrenador.
resources.Translated: 选择教练菜单后，食物清单并未打开。

resources.Key: Collection was requested; proof consumption and one matching fledgling must be reconciled before another request.
resources.Original: Recogida solicitada; reconcilia consumo del comprobante y una cría coincidente antes de repetir.
resources.Translated: 请求收集;在重复使用之前，先协调发票使用量和匹配的子代。

resources.Key: Load racing chocobo data first so the purchase plan can compare against sessions available.
resources.Original: Carga primero los datos del chocobo de carreras para comparar las compras con las sesiones disponibles.
resources.Translated: 首先上传赛车巧克力数据，将购买项目与可用会话进行比较。

resources.Original: Entrenamiento manual y compra de alimento

resources.Key: Inventory window disappeared before the trainer-feed context menu became visible.
resources.Original: El inventario desapareció antes de mostrar el menú de alimentación.
resources.Translated: 清单在显示电源菜单之前就消失了。

resources.Key: The active G{0} {1} duplicates an owned usable parent and no productive pair is available.
resources.Original: El G{0} {1} activo duplica un progenitor propio útil; no hay pareja productiva.
resources.Translated: 活跃的 G{0}{1}复制了一个有用的自身亲本;没有生产性伴侣。

resources.Key: This log has reached Dalamud's 100 MiB limit. Logging may have stopped, so recent activity may be missing and this log may not help troubleshoot your current issue.
resources.Original: Este registro ha alcanzado el límite de 100 MiB de Dalamud. Puede haber dejado de registrar; puede faltar actividad reciente y no servir para diagnosticar el problema actual.
resources.Translated: 此记录已达到 Dalamud 的 100 MiB 限制。它可能已停止记录;可能缺少最近的活动，无法用于诊断当前问题。

resources.Key: Breeding supply is purchased, but the supplier interaction did not release; Resume to reconcile the retained item.
resources.Original: Suministro comprado pero interacción del vendedor activa; Reanudar para reconciliar el objeto retenido.
resources.Translated: 已购买的物品，但卖方的互动仍在进行;重新连接以协调被扣留的物品。

resources.Key: Plan exceeds sessions available: {0}/{1}. The shopping list below still reflects the full plan.
resources.Original: El plan supera las sesiones disponibles: {0}/{1}. La lista sigue reflejando el plan completo.
resources.Translated: 计划超过可用会话数:{0}/{1}。列表仍然反映整个计划。

resources.Key: Collection requires the existing eligible covering, its retained-parent pedigree and exactly one Proof of Covering.
resources.Original: La recogida requiere cruce listo, linaje de padres retenidos y exactamente un comprobante.
resources.Translated: 收集需要快速交配、被扣留父母的血统，以及一份精确的证明。

resources.Key: Could not open '{0}' on Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Original: No se pudo abrir «{0}» en Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Translated: 无法在 Tack & Feed Trader 中打开 “{0}”。

resources.Key: Racing chocobo page detected; waiting for RaceChocoboManager data.
resources.Original: Página del corredor detectada; esperando RaceChocoboManager.
resources.Translated: 检测到走廊页面;正在等待 RaceChocoboManager。

resources.Key: Target pedigree G{0} is outside G2-G9.
resources.Original: Linaje objetivo G{0} fuera de G2–G9.
resources.Translated: 目标线 G{0}在 G2-G9 之外。
