resources.Translated: ZIP 日志已准备就绪。手动共享并删除不需要的旧导出。

resources.Key: Planned trainings exceed sessions available: {0}/{1}. Extra planned trainings will not fit this cycle.
resources.Original: Latihan yang direncanakan melebihi sesi tersedia: {0}/{1}. Latihan tambahan tidak muat dalam siklus ini.
resources.Translated: 计划超过会话时间的练习可用:{0}/{1}。额外的练习不适用于这个周期。

resources.Key: Feed confirmation would cross the configured currency reserve.
resources.Original: Konfirmasi pakan akan mengurangi cadangan mata uang yang diatur.
resources.Translated: 确认饲料将减少规定的货币储备。

resources.Key: The verified required-supply shop closed before purchase.
resources.Original: Toko persediaan wajib yang terverifikasi ditutup sebelum pembelian.
resources.Translated: 经过验证的强制性商店在购买前关闭。

resources.Key: A usable G{0} pair is already retained. Select owned parents or advance-pedigree permits before another covering.
resources.Original: Pasangan G{0} yang dapat digunakan sudah disimpan. Pilih induk milik sendiri atau izin peningkatan silsilah sebelum perkawinan lain.
resources.Translated: 可使用的 G{0}对已保存。在进行其他交配之前，请选择自己的母亲或血统升级许可。

resources.Key: Could not find Tack & Feed Trader in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Tidak dapat menemukan Tack & Feed Trader di Chocobo Square.
resources.Translated: 在 Chocobo 广场找不到 Tack & Feed Trader。

resources.Key: Projected from current stats using {0} planned trainings.
resources.Original: Diproyeksikan dari atribut saat ini memakai {0} latihan terencana.
resources.Translated: 从当前属性投射，使用计划的练习{0}。

resources.Key: Reload found an unverified feeding intent; it will not be replayed.
resources.Original: Pemuatan ulang menemukan niat pemberian pakan yang belum terverifikasi; niat itu tidak akan dijalankan ulang.
resources.Translated: 重新载入检测到未经验证的喂食意图;该意图不会重新运行。

resources.Key: Feed purchase completed without an exact item-ID quantity increase.
resources.Original: Pembelian pakan selesai tanpa peningkatan jumlah item dengan ID yang tepat.
resources.Translated: 购买完成，无需使用正确 ID 增加商品数量。

resources.Key: Could not start Lifestream travel to Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Tidak dapat memulai perjalanan Lifestream ke Chocobo Square.
resources.Translated: 无法启动前往 Chocobo 广场的 Lifestream 之旅。

resources.Key: Required-supply shop closed before the purchase result was verified.
resources.Original: Toko persediaan wajib ditutup sebelum hasil pembelian terverifikasi.
resources.Translated: 在确认购买结果之前，强制关闭商店。

resources.Original: Utamakan alur yang transparan dan deterministik.
resources.Translated: 强化透明和确定性流程。

resources.Key: Use the active racer's remaining training sessions before retirement.
resources.Original: Gunakan sisa sesi latihan chocobo balap aktif sebelum pensiun.
resources.Translated: 在退役前使用剩余的赛车训练音频。

resources.Original: Tindakan pembiakan harus selesai dan G9 sudah tercapai.
resources.Translated: 繁育工作必须完成，G9 已经完成。

resources.Key: RaceChocoboManager did not load within 30 seconds after selecting the native Chocobo tab.
resources.Original: RaceChocoboManager tidak dimuat dalam 30 detik setelah memilih tab Chocobo native.
resources.Translated: RaceChocoboManager 在选择原生 Chocobo 选项卡后的 30 秒内不会加载。

resources.Key: Retire the active G{0} {1} racer exactly.

resources.Original: Niat pemberian pakan tersimpan tidak memiliki data awal item.
resources.Translated: 已保存的喂食意图没有项目的初始数据。

resources.Key: Fall back to Grade 1, then skip
resources.Original: Gunakan Grade 1 sebagai pengganti, lalu lewati
resources.Translated: 使用 1 级作为替换，然后跳过
没有注册巧克力味赛车。

resources.Key: Status Content ID does not match the current character.
resources.Original: Content ID status tidak cocok dengan karakter saat ini.
resources.Translated: 内容 ID 状态与当前角色不匹配。

resources.Key: Reconcile the existing covering before producing another offspring.
resources.Original: Cocokkan perkawinan yang ada sebelum menghasilkan anak lain.
resources.Translated: 在生育另一个孩子之前，请匹配现有的配对。

resources.Key: The initial racing tutorial awaits the next daily allowance.
resources.Original: Tutorial balapan awal menunggu jatah harian berikutnya.
resources.Translated: 初始比赛教程，等待下一天的配给。

resources.Key: Plan training sessions, use feed already in inventory, and buy the remaining feed in one visit.
resources.Original: Rencanakan sesi latihan, gunakan pakan yang ada di inventaris, lalu beli sisanya dalam satu kunjungan.
resources.Translated: 计划一次训练，使用库存中的食物，然后一次性购买剩余的。

resources.Key: Breeding UI mappings still require native inspection before automatic selection is available.
resources.Original: Pemetaan UI pembiakan masih memerlukan inspeksi native sebelum pemilihan otomatis tersedia.
resources.Translated: 生殖 UI 映射在自动选择可用之前，仍需要进行原生检查。

resources.Key: Counterpart covering requires permit mode and a reached pedigree of G2 or higher.
resources.Original: Perkawinan untuk menghasilkan pasangan memerlukan mode izin dan silsilah G2 atau lebih yang sudah dicapai.
resources.Translated: 配对需要 G2 或更高级别的许可模式和血统。

resources.Key: Cover retained G{0} parents; preserve their remaining capacity.
resources.Original: Kawinkan induk G{0} tersimpan; pertahankan kapasitas yang tersisa.
resources.Translated: G{0}母线配对已保存;保留剩余容量。

resources.Key: Persisted feed-purchase intent has no item baseline.
resources.Original: Niat pembelian pakan tersimpan tidak memiliki data awal item.
resources.Translated: 保存的饲料购买意向没有商品的初始数据。

resources.Original: Pendaftaran balapan dari petugas direkam; penerimaan latihan awal menunggu verifikasi.

resources.Key: Buy a G1 {0} registration form to raise a missing owned parent.
resources.Original: Beli formulir pendaftaran G1 {0} untuk membesarkan induk milik sendiri yang belum ada.

resources.Original: Pembelian pakan akan mengurangi cadangan mata uang yang diatur.

resources.Original: Chocobo balap G{0} terdaftar berada di bawah silsilah G{1} tersimpan; balapan generasi lebih rendah dihentikan.

resources.Original: Produksi anak memerlukan stok induk G9; balapan generasi lebih rendah dihentikan.

resources.Translated: 许可目标：创造当代缺失的合作伙伴

resources.Key: Loading current racer data before selecting a breeding action.
resources.Original: Caricamento corridore prima di scegliere l'azione allevamento.
resources.Translated: 在选择养殖操作之前进行跑步装载。

resources.Key: This progression requires V3; older callers cannot remove its spending limits.
resources.Original: Questa progressione richiede V3; i vecchi chiamanti non possono rimuovere i limiti di spesa.
resources.Translated: 这种进度需要 V3;旧呼叫者无法取消支出限制。

resources.Key: Selected registration form; the resulting registration window is captured for verification.
resources.Original: Modulo scelto; finestra registrazione registrata per verifica.
resources.Translated: 选择的模块;记录视窗已记录以供检查。

resources.Key: Timed out moving near Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Original: Tempo scaduto avvicinandosi a Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Translated: 接近 Tack & Feed Trader 的时间已经到期。

resources.Key: Feed for the available training sessions cannot be purchased within the currency reserves.
resources.Original: Mangime per le sessioni disponibili non acquistabile entro le riserve.
resources.Translated: 可用课程的食物，储备内无法购买。

resources.Key: No useful active racer, fledgling, or covering parents are available.
resources.Original: Nessun corridore, piccolo o genitore utile disponibile.
resources.Translated: 没有可用的跑步者、幼儿或有用的家长。

resources.Key: G{0} has already been reached; the target cannot move backwards.
resources.Original: G{0} già raggiunto; l'obiettivo non può arretrare.
resources.Translated: G{0}已经到达;目标不能后退。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer Info ready; waiting before Chocobo tab callback...
resources.Original: Info Gold Saucer pronte; attesa prima della scheda chocobo...
resources.Translated: 金碟信息已准备就绪;在巧克力卡前稍候......

resources.Key: Feeding did not produce one exact feed-item decrease and one confirmed-session decrease.
resources.Original: L'alimentazione non ha ridotto esattamente un mangime e una sessione confermata.
resources.Translated: 供电并未完全减少喂食量和确认的会话次数。

resources.Key: The required supply does not match the selected breeding mode and supplier.
resources.Original: Materiale richiesto non corrisponde a modalità e fornitore scelti.
resources.Translated: 请求的材料与所选型号和供应商不符。

resources.Key: A free main-inventory slot is required for the breeding supply.
resources.Original: Serve uno spazio libero nell'inventario principale per il materiale.
resources.Translated: 需要在主要材料库存中留出空间。

resources.Key: Could not open Tack & Feed Trader. Move closer and try again.
resources.Original: Impossibile aprire Tack & Feed Trader. Avvicinati e riprova.
resources.Translated: 无法打开 Tack & Feed Trader。靠近并再试一次。

resources.Key: Ready to plan the next action
resources.Original: Pronto a pianificare la prossima azione

resources.Key: Collection occurred, but the exact new offspring and its trait must be reconciled before counting or another covering.
resources.Original: Ritiro avvenuto; riconcilia piccolo esatto e tratto prima del conteggio o nuovo accoppiamento.
resources.Translated: 已完成的退出;在计数或重新交配之前，精确调整小尺寸和长度。

resources.Key: Cannot skip feeding without a current racer snapshot.
resources.Original: Impossibile saltare senza dati attuali del corridore.
resources.Translated: 没有跑步者的当前数据，就无法进行跳跃。

resources.Key: The desired inherited ability is unavailable in current game data.
resources.Original: Abilità ereditata desiderata assente nei dati attuali.
resources.Translated: 目前数据中缺乏所需的遗传能力。

resources.Key: The native Select Chocobo list entry is unavailable or disabled.
resources.Original: Voce nativa Select Chocobo non disponibile o disattivata.
resources.Translated: 原生声音 Select Chocobo 不可用或已禁用。

resources.Key: Produced {0}/{1} matching G9 offspring; retained unregistered.
resources.Original: Prodotti {0}/{1} piccoli G9 corrispondenti; conservati non registrati.
resources.Translated: 相应的小型 G9 产品{0}/{1};保存未注册。

resources.Key: Scroll down to "The Dumpster Fire" channel to discuss issues / suggestions for specific plugins.
resources.Original: Visita il canale «The Dumpster Fire» per problemi e suggerimenti sui plugin.
resources.Translated: 请访问 “The Dumpster Fire” 频道，了解插件问题和建议。

resources.Key: Exact shopping list for the current plan.
resources.Original: Lista acquisti esatta per il piano attuale.
resources.Translated: 当前计划的准确购物清单。

resources.Key: The observed Chocobo tab is not ready for its native button event.
resources.Original: La scheda chocobo osservata non è pronta per l'evento nativo del pulsante.
resources.Translated: 观察到的 Chocobo 卡尚未准备好处理按钮的原生事件。

resources.Key: Reserve stable and vendor automation seams.
resources.Original: Predisponi interfacce di automazione per stalla e venditore.
resources.Translated: 为仓库和销售人员设置自动化界面。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer window did not appear in time.
resources.Original: Finestra Gold Saucer non apparsa in tempo.
resources.Translated: 金碟窗口没有及时出现。

resources.Key: The observed retirement confirmation button is unavailable.
resources.Original: Pulsante di conferma ritiro osservato non disponibile.
resources.Translated: 确认按钮已观察到不可用。

resources.Key: Pass {0}: buying missing feed ({1} sessions remain).
resources.Original: Passaggio {0}: acquisto mangime mancante ({1} sessioni rimaste).
resources.Translated: 步骤{0}:购买缺失的饲料 ({1}剩余会话)。

resources.Key: Initial racing tutorial admitted; VERMAXION owns the race.
resources.Original: Tutorial iniziale ammesso; VERMAXION gestisce la corsa.
resources.Translated: 初始教程接受;Vermaxion 负责比赛。

resources.Key: The native gil-shop purchase could not be dispatched safely.
resources.Original: Impossibile inviare in sicurezza l'acquisto nativo in gil.
resources.Translated: 无法安全发送本地购买的吉尔币。

resources.Key: Trainer feed inventory did not open after selecting the trainer menu entry.
resources.Original: Inventario mangime non aperto dopo la selezione del menu allenatore.
resources.Translated: 选择教练菜单后未打开的饲料库存。

resources.Key: Collection was requested; proof consumption and one matching fledgling must be reconciled before another request.
resources.Original: Ritiro richiesto; riconcilia consumo prova e un piccolo corrispondente prima di ripetere.
resources.Translated: 要求退款;在重复之前，协调试用消费和一个小额对应项。

resources.Key: Load racing chocobo data first so the purchase plan can compare against sessions available.
resources.Original: Carica prima i dati del chocobo da corsa per confrontare gli acquisti con le sessioni disponibili.
resources.Translated: 首先上传 Chocobo 比赛数据，将购买项目与可用赛程进行比较。

resources.Key: Inventory window disappeared before the trainer-feed context menu became visible.
resources.Original: Inventario scomparso prima del menu alimentazione.
resources.Translated: 在电源菜单之前消失的库存。

resources.Key: The active G{0} {1} duplicates an owned usable parent and no productive pair is available.
resources.Original: G{0} {1} attivo duplica un genitore utile; nessuna coppia produttiva.
resources.Translated: G{0} {1} 活跃的双亲;无生产性配对。

resources.Key: This log has reached Dalamud's 100 MiB limit. Logging may have stopped, so recent activity may be missing and this log may not help troubleshoot your current issue.
resources.Original: Questo registro ha raggiunto il limite di 100 MiB di Dalamud. La registrazione potrebbe essersi fermata; le attività recenti potrebbero mancare e il registro potrebbe non aiutare a diagnosticare il problema attuale.
resources.Translated: 此日志已达到 Dalamud 的 100 MiB 限制。日志记录可能已停止;最近的活动可能已消失，而且日志记录可能无法帮助诊断当前问题。

resources.Key: Breeding supply is purchased, but the supplier interaction did not release; Resume to reconcile the retained item.
resources.Original: Materiale acquistato ma interazione venditore attiva; Riprendi per riconciliare l'oggetto conservato.
resources.Translated: 已购买材料，但卖方互动仍在进行;恢复以协调保存的物品。

resources.Key: Plan exceeds sessions available: {0}/{1}. The shopping list below still reflects the full plan.
resources.Original: Il piano supera le sessioni disponibili: {0}/{1}. La lista mostra comunque il piano completo.
resources.Translated: 计划超过可用会话:{0}/{1}。列表仍然显示完整的计划。

resources.Key: Collection requires the existing eligible covering, its retained-parent pedigree and exactly one Proof of Covering.
resources.Original: Il ritiro richiede accoppiamento pronto, generazione dei genitori conservati e una sola prova.
resources.Translated: 退休需要现成的交配、生育保存的父母，以及一次性测试。

resources.Key: Could not open '{0}' on Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Original: Impossibile aprire «{0}» da Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Translated: 无法在 Tack & Feed Trader 打开 “{0}”。

resources.Key: Racing chocobo page detected; waiting for RaceChocoboManager data.
resources.Translated: 检测到跑道页面;等待 RaceChocoboManager。

resources.Key: Target pedigree G{0} is outside G2-G9.
resources.Original: Generazione obiettivo G{0} fuori da G2–G9.
resources.Translated: G2-G9 之外的 G{0}目标生成。

resources.Key: Automation uses the session-capped plan and subtracts feed already on hand before buying.
resources.Original: L'automazione limita il piano alle sessioni disponibili e sottrae il mangime in stock prima dell'acquisto.
resources.Translated: 自动化将套餐限制在可用的会话内，并在购买前从库存中扣除饲料。

resources.Key: Target cycle paused at a safe boundary.
resources.Original: Ciclo obiettivo in pausa a un punto sicuro.
resources.Translated: 将目标周期暂停至安全点。

resources.Key: No visible inventory window was found while opening the trainer-feed context menu.
resources.Original: Nessuna finestra inventario visibile aprendo il menu alimentazione.
resources.Translated: 打开电源菜单时，未显示任何清单窗口。
饲料：等级{0} 如果不可用:{1}

resources.Key: Covering wait has no valid eligibility evidence.
resources.Original: Attesa accoppiamento senza prova valida di idoneità.
resources.Translated: 等待配对，无需有效的资格证明。

resources.Key: Raise this non-matching G9 offspring as the missing owned counterpart; retain matching outputs.
resources.Original: Alleva questo piccolo G9 non adatto come partner mancante; conserva quelli adatti.
resources.Translated: 养育这个不适合作为缺失伴侣的小 G9;保留那些适合的。

resources.Key: Commence window did not appear after selecting Feed.
resources.Original: Finestra Avvia non apparsa dopo Alimenta.
resources.Translated: 阿维亚窗口在阿里曼塔之后就没有出现。

resources.Key: Discard is permanent. G9 stock, covering proof and selected breeding inputs are protected.
resources.Original: Lo scarto è definitivo. Le scorte G9, le prove di accoppiamento e i materiali selezionati per l'allevamento sono protetti.
resources.Translated: 废弃物是最终的。G9 库存、配对试验和育种材料选择都得到了保护。

resources.Key: The active racer's sex is unavailable.
resources.Original: Sesso del corridore attivo non disponibile.
resources.Translated: 活跃跑者的性别不可用。

resources.Key: Purchase callback for {0} did not change inventory. Last attempted: {1}
resources.Original: L'acquisto di {0} non ha modificato l'inventario. Ultimo tentativo: {1}
resources.Translated: 购买{0}并未改变库存。最后一次尝试:{1}

resources.Key: Breeding, character or stock changed; cleanup stopped.
resources.Original: Allevamento, personaggio o scorte sono cambiati; pulizia interrotta.
resources.Translated: 饲养、角色或库存已更改;清洁工作已停止。

resources.Key: Could not path near Tack & Feed Trader. Move closer or check vnavmesh.
resources.Original: Nessun percorso verso Tack & Feed Trader. Avvicinati o controlla vnavmesh.
resources.Translated: 没有 Tack & Feed Trader 的路径。靠近或查看 vnavmesh。

resources.Key: Review the selected stock before discarding.
resources.Original: Controlla le scorte selezionate prima di scartarle.
resources.Translated: 在丢弃之前，请检查所选库存。

resources.Key: Start a new offspring batch only after the existing action, queue and covering have settled.
resources.Original: Avvia un nuovo lotto solo quando azione, coda e accoppiamento attuali sono terminati.
resources.Translated: 仅在当前操作、队列和配对完成后才开始新批次。

resources.Key: Could not find Race Chocobo Trainer in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Race Chocobo Trainer non trovato a Chocobo Square.
resources.Translated: 赛车巧克力教练在巧克力广场失踪。

resources.Key: The retained covering parent changed before native selection.
resources.Original: Genitore conservato cambiato prima della selezione nativa.
resources.Translated: 保留父母在自然选择之前发生了变化。
相应的后代已保存但未注册。

resources.Key: The selected registration form changed before opening its context menu.
resources.Original: Modulo selezionato cambiato prima di aprire il menu.
resources.Translated: 所选模块在打开菜单前已更改。

resources.Key: Current racer pedigree, racing rank, or sex is unavailable.
resources.Original: Generazione, rango o sesso del corridore attuale non disponibili.
resources.Translated: 当前跑步者的出生年代、级别或性别不可用。

resources.Key: Retirement requires an intermediate rank40 racer and room for its retained form.
resources.Original: Il ritiro richiede corridore intermedio rango40 e spazio per il modulo.
resources.Translated: 退役需要 40 级中级跑者和模块的空间。

resources.Key: Log ZIP ready. Share it manually; remove old exports when you no longer need them.
resources.Original: ZIP del registro pronto. Condividilo manualmente ed elimina le esportazioni non più necessarie.
resources.Translated: 注册表 ZIP 已准备就绪。手动共享并删除不再需要的出口。

resources.Key: Planned trainings exceed sessions available: {0}/{1}. Extra planned trainings will not fit this cycle.
resources.Original: Sessioni pianificate oltre quelle disponibili: {0}/{1}. Le sessioni extra non rientrano nel ciclo.
resources.Translated: 超出可用范围的计划会话:{0}/{1}。额外的会话不在循环范围内。

resources.Key: Feed confirmation would cross the configured currency reserve.
resources.Original: La conferma mangime violerebbe la riserva valuta impostata.
resources.Translated: 确认进食将违反设定的外汇储备。

resources.Key: The verified required-supply shop closed before purchase.
resources.Original: Negozio materiali verificato chiuso prima dell'acquisto.
resources.Translated: 购买前已核实已关闭的材料商店。

resources.Key: A usable G{0} pair is already retained. Select owned parents or advance-pedigree permits before another covering.
resources.Original: Coppia G{0} utile conservata. Scegli genitori propri o permessi avanzamento prima di un altro accoppiamento.
resources.Translated: 保留有用的 G{0}配对。选择自己的父母，或者在进行另一次配对之前允许进阶。

resources.Key: Could not find Tack & Feed Trader in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Trader non trovato a Chocobo Square.
resources.Translated: 在 Chocobo 广场未找到 Tack & Feed Trader。

resources.Key: Projected from current stats using {0} planned trainings.
resources.Original: Proiezione dalle statistiche attuali con {0} sessioni previste.
resources.Translated: 根据当前统计数据进行投影，预计会话为{0}。

resources.Key: Reload found an unverified feeding intent; it will not be replayed.
resources.Original: Ricaricamento: intento alimentazione non verificato; non verrà ripetuto.
resources.Translated: 充电：电源意图未经验证;不会重复。

resources.Key: Feed purchase completed without an exact item-ID quantity increase.
resources.Original: Acquisto completato senza aumento esatto della quantità dell'ID oggetto.
resources.Translated: 完成购买，未精确增加对象 ID 数量。

resources.Key: Could not start Lifestream travel to Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Impossibile avviare Lifestream verso Chocobo Square.
resources.Translated: 无法启动前往 Chocobo 广场的 Lifestream。

resources.Key: Required-supply shop closed before the purchase result was verified.
resources.Original: Negozio materiali chiuso prima della verifica acquisto.
resources.Translated: 材料商店在购买确认前关闭。

resources.Key: Use the active racer's remaining training sessions before retirement.
resources.Original: Usa le sessioni rimanenti del corridore prima del ritiro.
resources.Translated: 使用跑者在退役前剩余的训练时间。

resources.Key: Breeding must be settled and G9 reached.
resources.Original: Le azioni di allevamento devono essere concluse e G9 raggiunto.
resources.Translated: 养殖行动必须完成，并实现 G9 目标。

resources.Key: RaceChocoboManager did not load within 30 seconds after selecting the native Chocobo tab.
resources.Original: RaceChocoboManager non caricato entro 30 secondi dalla selezione della scheda.
resources.Translated: RaceChocoboManager 在选择卡后 30 秒内未加载。

resources.Key: Retire the active G{0} {1} racer exactly.
resources.Original: Ritira il corridore attivo G{0} {1} esatto.
resources.Translated: 取出正确的活跃跑者 G{0} {1}。

resources.Key: Persisted feeding intent has no item baseline.
resources.Original: Intento alimentazione salvato senza riferimento oggetto.
resources.Translated: 电源意图保存时未参考对象。

resources.Key: Fall back to Grade 1, then skip
resources.Translated: 升级到 1 级，然后跳过

resources.Key: Status Content ID does not match the current character.
resources.Original: Content ID di stato diverso dal personaggio attuale.
resources.Translated: 内容 ID 状态与当前角色不同。

resources.Key: Reconcile the existing covering before producing another offspring.
resources.Original: Riconcilia l'accoppiamento attuale prima di produrre altri piccoli.
resources.Translated: 在产下更多幼崽之前，协调当前的交配关系。

resources.Key: The initial racing tutorial awaits the next daily allowance.
resources.Original: Tutorial iniziale in attesa del prossimo limite giornaliero.
resources.Translated: 初始教程，等待下一个每日限额。

resources.Key: Plan training sessions, use feed already in inventory, and buy the remaining feed in one visit.
resources.Original: Pianifica le sessioni, usa il mangime disponibile e acquista il resto in una visita.
resources.Translated: 安排课程，使用可用的饲料，并在一次访问中购买剩余的饲料。

resources.Key: Breeding UI mappings still require native inspection before automatic selection is available.
resources.Original: Le mappature allevamento richiedono verifica nativa prima della selezione automatica.
resources.Translated: 畜牧业映射需要在自动选择之前进行原生验证。

resources.Key: Counterpart covering requires permit mode and a reached pedigree of G2 or higher.
resources.Original: Accoppiamento partner richiede permessi e generazione G2 o superiore raggiunta.
resources.Translated: 合作伙伴配对需要获得许可并达到 G2 或更高版本。

resources.Key: Cover retained G{0} parents; preserve their remaining capacity.
resources.Original: Accoppia genitori G{0} conservati; preserva la capacità restante.
resources.Translated: 匹配保留的父 G{0};保留剩余容量。

resources.Key: Choose your progression goal, reserves and feeding policy in VERMAXION settings, then Resume to begin.
resources.Original: Scegli obiettivo, riserve e politica di alimentazione in VERMAXION, poi premi Riprendi.
resources.Translated: 在 Vermaxion 中选择目标、储备和电源政策，然后点击 “继续”。

resources.Key: Persisted feed-purchase intent has no item baseline.
resources.Original: Intento acquisto salvato senza riferimento oggetto.
resources.Translated: 保存购买意图时未引用对象。

resources.Key: Registrar race entry captured; initial training admission is awaiting verification.
resources.Original: Voce corsa registrata; ammissione iniziale non verificata.
resources.Translated: 跑步语音已记录;初始输入未经验证。
许可目标：生产小型 G9

resources.Key: Buy a G1 {0} registration form to raise a missing owned parent.
resources.Original: Acquista modulo G1 {0} per allevare il genitore proprio mancante.
resources.Translated: 购买 G1 模块{0}来抚养正好缺失的父母。
撤退范围 {0} 在 40-50 之外。

resources.Key: Another Choke-abo automation owns the feed/vendor services.
resources.Translated: 另一个 Choke-abo 自动化负责电源/供应商管理。

resources.Key: Feed purchase would cross the configured currency reserve.
resources.Original: L'acquisto mangime violerebbe la riserva valuta impostata.
resources.Translated: 购买饲料将违反设定的外汇储备。

resources.Key: This target cycle is owned by VERMAXION; use its Target Pedigree controls.
resources.Original: VERMAXION gestisce questo ciclo; usa i suoi controlli generazione obiettivo.
resources.Translated: VERMAXION 管理这个循环，使用其目标生成控制。

resources.Key: The registered G{0} racer is below the retained G{1} pedigree; lower-generation racing is stopped.
resources.Original: Corridore G{0} sotto la generazione G{1} conservata; corse inferiori fermate.
resources.Translated: G{0}跑道位于保存的 G{1}代之下;低级跑道已停止。

resources.Key: Offspring production requires G9 breeding stock; lower-generation racing is stopped.
resources.Original: La produzione richiede scorte G9; corse di generazioni inferiori fermate.
resources.Translated: 生产需要 G9 级库存;下一代产品已停产。

resources.Key: The feed batch is not fully present in inventory; reconcile its pending purchases before another vendor visit.
resources.Original: Lotto incompleto nell'inventario; riconcilia gli acquisti pendenti prima di tornare al venditore.
resources.Translated: 库存中的未完成拍品;在返回卖方之前，对未完成的购买进行调整。

resources.Key: Cover the exact G{0} pair to produce the missing G{1} sex while the useful racer continues racing.
resources.Original: Accoppia coppia G{0} esatta per il sesso G{1} mancante mentre il corridore utile continua.
resources.Translated: 将 G{0}与缺失的 G{1}性别完美匹配，同时继续有用的跑步者。

resources.Key: Cover the retained G{0} parent and matching opposite-sex permit to produce G{1}.
resources.Original: Accoppia genitore G{0} conservato e permesso adatto di sesso opposto per produrre G{1}.
resources.Translated: 父母 G{0}配对保留，并允许异性进行适当的配对，以产生 G{1}。

resources.Key: Use Refresh Chocobo Data or /chokeabo refresh to load racing chocobo stats.
resources.Original: Usa Aggiorna dati chocobo o /chokeabo refresh per caricare le statistiche.
resources.Translated: 使用更新 Chocobo 数据或/Chokeabo 刷新来加载统计数据。

resources.Key: An unowned Proof of Covering is present; its exact start time cannot be inferred safely.
resources.Original: Prova di accoppiamento non posseduta presente; inizio esatto non deducibile in sicurezza.
resources.Translated: 目前没有配对证据;无法安全推断确切开始时间。

resources.Key: Training confirmation window did not appear after Commence.
resources.Original: Conferma allenamento non apparsa dopo Avvia.
resources.Translated: 确认训练在 Avvia 之后未出现。

resources.Original: Mostra la lingua nella finestra principale
Dati del corridore registrato non disponibili.

resources.Key: The required breeding supply was not found in the verified native shop.
resources.Original: Materiale allevamento non trovato nel negozio nativo verificato.
resources.Translated: 在已核实的当地商店中未发现饲养材料。

resources.Key: Breeding service interaction captured; its native selection must be verified before dispatch.
resources.Original: Interazione allevamento registrata; verifica selezione nativa prima dell'invio.
resources.Translated: 注册养殖互动;发货前检查本地选择。

resources.Key: Cover matching G9 stock with its retained opposite-sex G9 parent.
resources.Original: Accoppia scorte G9 adatte con genitore G9 conservato di sesso opposto.
resources.Translated: 将适合的 G9 库存与异性保留的 G9 父母进行匹配。

resources.Key: Refresh requested; opening Gold Saucer window...
resources.Translated: 请求更新;开启 Gold Saucer...

resources.Key: No logged-in Content ID is available.
resources.Original: Nessun Content ID di accesso disponibile.
resources.Translated: 没有可用的内容登录 ID。
内容 ID 不同：请求 {0}，当前 {1}。

resources.Key: Register the exact G{0} fledgling in {1} slot {2}.
resources.Original: Registra il piccolo G{0} esatto in {1}, spazio {2}.
resources.Translated: 将小 G{0}精确记录在{1}，空格{2}中。

resources.Key: Feeding one {0}; awaiting exact item and session evidence.
resources.Original: Alimentazione con un {0}; attesa prove esatte di oggetto e sessione.
resources.Translated: 使用{0}进行供电;等待对象和会话的准确测试。

resources.Key: Complete the registrar's initial racing training course.
resources.Original: Completa il corso iniziale dell'addetto alle iscrizioni.
resources.Translated: 完成注册管理员的初始课程。

resources.Key: Track current stats and feed plans.
resources.Translated: 遵循统计数据和饲料计划。

resources.Key: Raise the matching G9 parent to retirement: racing rank {0}/40. Matching offspring stay unregistered.
resources.Original: Alleva il genitore G9 adatto fino al ritiro: rango {0}/40. Piccoli corrispondenti non registrati.
resources.Translated: 养育合适的 G9 型父母直到退休：范围{0}/40。未注册的匹配小型动物。

resources.Key: UI fonts failed to load. See the plugin log.
resources.Original: Impossibile caricare i caratteri. Consulta il log del plugin.
resources.Translated: 无法加载字符。请查看插件日志。

resources.Key: No usable G{0} parent remains to produce a G{1} counterpart. Lower-generation covering is stopped.
resources.Original: Nessun genitore G{0} utile per partner G{1}. Accoppiamenti inferiori fermati.
resources.Translated: 没有父母 G{0}对伴侣 G{1}有用。下级配对停止。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer Info ready; waiting before Chocobo tab callback.
resources.Original: Info Gold Saucer pronte; attesa prima della scheda chocobo.
resources.Translated: 金碟信息已准备就绪;请在巧克力卡前稍候。

resources.Key: A Proof of Covering is present.
Native racing unlock verified; reassessing feeding and racing.
resources.Original: Sblocco nativo verificato; rivalutazione alimentazione e corse.
resources.Translated: 本地解锁已验证;营养和跑步重新评估。

resources.Original: 一時停止中・再開が必要
対象となる在庫がありません。
飼料の所持品画面待ち…

resources.Key: XA Slave log tools could not be opened.
resources.Original: XA Slaveのログツールを開けませんでした。
resources.Translated: 未打开 XA Slave 的日志工具。

resources.Key: The registered G9 racer does not have a confirmed requested trait. Retain it and select suitable breeding stock.
resources.Original: 登録G9レーサーの希望特性を確認できません。保持し、適切な交配ストックを選んでください。
resources.Translated: 无法确认注册 G9 赛车的理想特性。请保留并选择合适的配送库存。

resources.Original: 登録レーサーを確認中

resources.Key: Complete Like Sire Like Fledgling before retiring this racer.
resources.Original: 引退させる前にLike Sire Like Fledglingを完了してください。
resources.Translated: 请在退役之前完成 Like Sire Like Fledling。

resources.Key: Stock cleanup is active; stop it before starting breeding.
resources.Original: 在庫整理中です。育成を開始する前に停止してください。
resources.Translated: 正在整理库存。请在开始培育之前停止。

resources.Key: Paused by VERMAXION at a safe boundary.
resources.Original: VERMAXIONが安全な区切りで一時停止しました。
resources.Translated: VERMAXION 在安全区间暂时停止了。
正在移动到 Race Chocobo Trainer......

resources.Key: The Tack & Feed Trader is unavailable for interaction.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Traderを操作できません。
resources.Translated: 无法操作 Tack & Feed Trader。

resources.Key: Purchased feed could not be resolved to an exact inventory slot.
resources.Original: 購入飼料の正確な所持品枠を特定できません。
resources.Translated: 无法确定购买饲料的准确持有范围。

resources.Original: 在庫の整理が完了しました。
ログをエクスポート中...

resources.Key: Offspring sex is random. Two coverings do not guarantee a male and a female.
resources.Original: 子の性別はランダムです。2回交配しても雌雄が揃うとは限りません。
resources.Translated: 孩子的性别是随机的。即使进行两次交配，也不一定雌雄同体。

resources.Key: The acceptable colours are unavailable in current game data.
resources.Original: 指定した許容色が現在のゲームデータにありません。
resources.Translated: 当前游戏数据中没有指定的允许颜色。

resources.Key: The required covering fee would cross the gil reserve. Explicit Resume is required.
resources.Original: 必要交配料金でギル下限を割ります。明示的な再開が必要です。
resources.Translated: 以所需交配费用除以基尔下限。需要明确重新开始。

resources.Key: Log into a character before starting breeding automation.
resources.Original: 交配の自動処理を始める前にログインしてください。
resources.Translated: 请在开始自动配送处理之前登录。

resources.Key: Missing a usable opposite-sex G9 parent. Owned mode requires suitable G9 stock or an explicit switch to NPC permits.
resources.Original: 使用可能な異性G9親がいません。自前モードには適切なG9かNPC許可証への明示切替が必要です。
resources.Translated: 没有可用的异性 G9 父母。自主模式需要明确切换到适当的 G9 或 NPC 许可证。

resources.Key: Timed out moving near Race Chocobo Trainer.
resources.Original: Race Chocobo Trainerへの移動がタイムアウトしました。
resources.Translated: 前往 Race Chocobo Trainer 的时间已超时。

resources.Key: The current racer exceeds the selected target pedigree; retain it.
resources.Original: 現在のレーサーは目標血統を超えています。保持してください。
resources.Translated: 当前赛车手已超过目标血统。请保留。

resources.Key: The selected covering stock is captured; native selected-parent evidence and the fee require verification before Commence.
resources.Original: 選択ストックを記録済み。開始前に実選択親の証拠と料金を検証してください。
resources.Translated: 选择库存已记录。开始之前，请验证实际选择父项的证据和费用。

resources.Original: ログのエクスポートに失敗しました。
上限に達したログをエクスポート

resources.Key: Pause Content ID does not match the current character.
resources.Original: 一時停止のContent IDが現在のキャラクターと一致しません。
resources.Translated: 暂停的 Content ID 与当前角色不匹配。

resources.Key: No usable retired G9 parent has a confirmed requested trait. Retain offspring and replenish suitable G9 stock.
resources.Original: 希望特性を確認済みの使用可能な引退G9親がありません。子を保持して適切なG9を補充してください。
resources.Translated: 目前尚无符合条件的退休 G9 父母。请保留您的孩子，并补充适当的 G9。

resources.Key: No breeding forms or covering proof in inventory.
resources.Original: 所持品に交配用登録証や交配証明書がありません。
resources.Translated: 随身携带的物品没有交配登记证或交配证明。

resources.Original: 訓練計画をクリアしました。

resources.Key: Cleanup complete: no planned training remains.
resources.Original: 後処理完了：予定訓練は残っていません。
resources.Translated: 后续处理完成：预定的训练计划已完成。

resources.Key: Feed the target racer before declaring it ready.
resources.Original: 準備完了とする前に目標レーサーへ給餌してください。
resources.Translated: 在准备完成之前，请给目标赛车手喂食。

resources.Original: チョコボスクウェアへ移動中…
resources.Translated: 正在前往巧克力博斯克广场途中......

resources.Key: Reload found an unverified feed-purchase intent; it will not be replayed.
resources.Original: 再読込で未確認の飼料購入を検出。再実行しません。
resources.Translated: 重新加载检测到未确认的饲料购买。不会再次执行。

resources.Key: Target inputs changed while an immediate feed action was awaiting evidence.
resources.Original: 即時給餌の結果確認待ちに目標入力が変わりました。
resources.Translated: 目标输入变更为等待即时喂食结果确认。

resources.Key: Covering is eligible; collection requires a verified native UI mapping.
resources.Original: 交配は引き取り可能です。回収には検証済みネイティブUI対応が必要です。
resources.Translated: 配送可以取回。回收需要经过验证的原生 UI 支持。

resources.Original: Race Chocobo Trainerを開いています…
resources.Translated: 正在打开 Race Chocobo Trainer......
正在前往 Tack & Feed Trader......

resources.Key: Covering Commence was dispatched; its exact confirmation or proof result must be reconciled before another covering.
resources.Original: 交配開始を実行済み。次の交配前に正確な確認画面か証明書の結果を照合してください。
resources.Translated: 交配开始已完成。请在下次交配前核对准确的确认画面或证书结果。

resources.Key: The covering confirmation would cross the gil reserve. Explicit Resume is required.
resources.Original: 交配確認でギル下限を割ります。明示的な再開が必要です。
resources.Translated: 在交配确认中降低基尔下限。需要明确恢复。

resources.Key: Could not reach the required breeding service for native UI inspection.
resources.Original: ネイティブUI確認用の交配サービスに到達できません。
resources.Translated: 无法访问原生 UI 确认的配送服务。

resources.Key: Retirement confirmation sent; awaiting the retired form and cleared current racer. Any further native prompt is captured before another action.
resources.Original: 引退確認を送信済み。登録証とレーサー消去待ち。追加画面は次の操作前に記録します。
resources.Translated: 退役确认已发送。注册证和激光器擦除等待。在下一步操作之前记录额外画面。

resources.Key: Finish the existing covering with its saved goal before changing the production target.
resources.Original: 生産目標を変える前に、保存済み目標で現在の交配を完了してください。
resources.Translated: 在更改生产目标之前，请使用已保存的目标完成当前交配。

resources.Key: Cleanup did not start: load racing chocobo data first.
resources.Original: 後処理を開始できません。レーサー情報を先に読み込んでください。
resources.Translated: 无法开始后续处理。请先读取赛车手信息。

resources.Key: A required-supply purchase is unverified after reload; its matching pending confirmation or inventory result is required before another purchase.
resources.Original: 再読込後の物資購入は未確認です。再購入前に一致する保留確認か所持品結果が必要です。
resources.Translated: 重新下载后的物品购买尚未确认。重新购买前需要进行匹配的保留确认或物品结果。

resources.Key: Could not path near Race Chocobo Trainer. Move closer or check vnavmesh.
resources.Original: Race Chocobo Trainerへの経路を作れません。近づくかvnavmeshを確認してください。
resources.Translated: 无法创建通往 Race Chocobo Trainer 的路径。请查看 vnavmesh 是否接近。

resources.Key: vnavmesh is unavailable or not ready for target feeding.
resources.Original: 目標給餌に必要なvnavmeshが使用不可か未準備です。
resources.Translated: 目标喂食所需的 vnavmesh 不可用或未准备就绪。

resources.Key: Covering is eligible; adoption is awaiting exact capture evidence.
resources.Original: 交配は引き取り可能です。正確な記録証拠待ち。
resources.Translated: 交配可以取消。正在等待准确的记录证据。

resources.Key: Context menu disappeared before Feed could be selected.
resources.Original: 給餌を選ぶ前にコンテキストメニューが閉じました。
resources.Translated: 在选择喂食之前，上下文菜单关闭了。

resources.Key: Reconcile the existing Proof of Covering before another covering.
resources.Original: 次の交配前に既存の交配証明書を照合してください。
resources.Translated: 请在下次交配前核对现有交配证书。

resources.Key: Current racer data has not been loaded.
resources.Original: 現在のレーサー情報は未読込です。
resources.Translated: 当前的激光信息尚未加载。

resources.Key: No free main-inventory slot is available for target feed.
resources.Original: 目標飼料用の空き所持品枠がありません。
resources.Translated: 没有可用于目标饲料的空余物品栏。

resources.Key: Timed out waiting to arrive in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: チョコボスクウェアへの移動がタイムアウトしました。
resources.Translated: 前往巧克力广场的行程已超时。

resources.Key: Required Lifestream/vnavmesh vendor interaction is unavailable.
resources.Original: 必要なLifestream/vnavmeshの商店操作が使用できません。
resources.Translated: 无法使用必要的 Lifestream/vnavmesh 商店操作。

resources.Key: Feed selection changed after purchase; exact purchase evidence cannot be reconciled.
resources.Original: 購入後に飼料選択が変わり、購入結果を正確に照合できません。
resources.Translated: 购买后，饲料选择发生变化，无法准确匹配购买结果。

resources.Key: Saved collection evidence is invalid; no collection will be replayed.
resources.Original: 保存済み回収証拠が無効です。回収を再実行しません。
resources.Translated: 已保存的回收证据无效。不会重新执行回收。

resources.Original: 許可証の目的：血統を進める
resources.Translated: 许可证的目的：促进血统传承

resources.Original: レーサー情報を待っています…

resources.Key: The completed feed batch does not contain the current training selection.
resources.Original: 完了した飼料バッチに現在の訓練選択が含まれません。
resources.Translated: 完成的饲料批次不包括当前的训练选择。

resources.Original: XA Slaveのログツールを開く
resources.Translated: 打开 XA Slave 日志工具

resources.Key: Log into a character to see chocobo progression.
resources.Original: キャラクターでログインするとチョコボの育成状況を表示します。
resources.Translated: 以角色身份登录后，您可以查看巧克力的培育状态。

resources.Key: Retirement menu selected; the resulting native window is captured before confirming retirement.
resources.Original: 引退メニューを選択済み。確認前に結果のネイティブ画面を記録します。
resources.Translated: 已选择退出菜单。确认前请记录结果的原生画面。
复制/ZIP 化 Damud 日志
通过 Ko-fi 提供支持

resources.Key: The selected target feed item could not be resolved.
resources.Original: 選択した目標飼料を特定できません。
resources.Translated: 无法识别选定的目标饲料。

resources.Original: 子の生産設定が無効です。

resources.Key: Could not open Race Chocobo Trainer. Move closer and try again.
resources.Original: Race Chocobo Trainerを開けません。近づいて再試行してください。
resources.Translated: 无法打开 Race Chocobo Trainer。请靠近重试。

resources.Key: Current currency is below the planned purchase total. Adjust the plan or stock up before the buy loop is enabled.
resources.Original: 購入計画に対して資金が不足しています。計画を調整するか資金を補充してください。
resources.Translated: 购买计划资金不足。请调整计划或补充资金。

resources.Original: メインウィンドウにコンパクト切替を表示
resources.Translated: 在主窗口中显示紧凑型切换

resources.Key: VERMAXION owns progression settings and the daily racing allowance. Choke-abo carries out feeding and breeding.
resources.Original: 育成設定と一日の出走枠はVERMAXIONが管理し、給餌と交配はChoke-aboが実行します。
resources.Translated: 培育设置和一天的出发时间由 VERMAXION 管理，饲料和交配由 Choke-abo 执行。

resources.Key: Registration confirmation was sent but matching form consumption and current racer evidence are unavailable.
resources.Original: 登録確認を送信しましたが、対象登録証の消費と現レーサーの証拠がありません。
resources.Translated: 我们已经发送了注册确认，但没有发现目标注册证的消耗和当前赛车手的证据。

resources.Key: Opens XA Slave's Utility > XA Mods panel, which contains Dalamud Log Cleaner.
resources.Original: Dalamud Log Cleanerを含むXA SlaveのUtility > XA Modsパネルを開きます。
resources.Translated: 打开 XA Slave 的 “实用工具”>“XA 调制” 面板，其中包含 Daramud Log Cleaner。

resources.Original: 非フォーカス時の待機時間 (秒)
resources.Translated: 非聚焦时的等待时间 (秒)

resources.Original: 残り計画がゼロになりました

resources.Key: Choose the number of training sessions and feed grade for each stat.
resources.Original: 各能力の訓練回数と飼料グレードを選択します。
resources.Translated: 选择每种能力的训练次数和饲料等级。

resources.Original: 飼料購入の予定はありません。
引退チョコボの登録証

resources.Key: Permit objective: produce a missing current-pedigree counterpart
resources.Original: 許可証の目的：現血統の不足する相手を作る
resources.Translated: 许可证的目的：创造现有血统不足的对象

resources.Key: Loading current racer data before selecting a breeding action.
resources.Original: 交配行動を選ぶ前に現在のレーサー情報を読み込み中。
resources.Translated: 在选择交配行为之前，正在读取当前的激光信息。

resources.Key: This progression requires V3; older callers cannot remove its spending limits.
resources.Original: この育成にはV3が必要です。旧呼び出し元は支出制限を解除できません。
resources.Translated: 这种培养需要 V3。旧呼叫方无法解除支出限制。

resources.Original: 非フォーカス時の不透明度 (%)

resources.Key: Selected registration form; the resulting registration window is captured for verification.
resources.Original: 登録証を選択済み。検証用に登録画面を記録します。
resources.Translated: 已选择注册证。记录注册画面以进行验证。

resources.Key: Timed out moving near Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Traderへの移動がタイムアウトしました。
resources.Translated: 切换到 Tack & Feed Trader 已超时。

resources.Key: Feed for the available training sessions cannot be purchased within the currency reserves.
resources.Original: 残り訓練分の飼料を資金下限内で購入できません。
resources.Translated: 无法在资金限制内购买剩余训练用饲料。

resources.Key: No useful active racer, fledgling, or covering parents are available.
resources.Original: 有用な現レーサー・子・交配親がありません。
resources.Translated: 目前没有有用的赛车手、子女和配偶。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer Info ready; waiting before Chocobo tab callback...
resources.Original: ゴールドソーサー情報準備完了。チョコボタブ呼び出し待ち…
resources.Translated: 淘金者信息准备完毕。呼叫巧克力棒等待中......

resources.Original: フォントを読み込み中…

resources.Key: Feeding did not produce one exact feed-item decrease and one confirmed-session decrease.
resources.Original: 飼料1個消費と訓練1回減少の両方を確認できません。
resources.Translated: 无法确认是否消耗了 1 个饲料和减少了 1 次训练。

resources.Key: The required supply does not match the selected breeding mode and supplier.
resources.Original: 必要物資が選択した交配モード・商店と一致しません。
resources.Translated: 所需物资与选择的配送模式商店不匹配。

resources.Key: A free main-inventory slot is required for the breeding supply.
resources.Original: 交配物資用にメイン所持品の空き枠が必要です。
resources.Translated: 配送物资需要主要持有物品的空格。

resources.Original: エクスポートフォルダーを開く

resources.Key: Could not open Tack & Feed Trader. Move closer and try again.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Traderを開けません。近づいて再試行してください。
resources.Translated: 无法打开 Tack & Feed Trader。请靠近并重试。

resources.Key: Ready to plan the next action
resources.Original: 次の行動を計画できます
resources.Translated: 您可以计划下一步行动

resources.Key: Collection occurred, but the exact new offspring and its trait must be reconciled before counting or another covering.
resources.Original: 引き取り済み。加算や次の交配前に、新しい子とその特性を正確に照合してください。
resources.Translated: 已领养。在加算或下次交配之前，请仔细核对新生儿及其特性。

resources.Key: Cannot skip feeding without a current racer snapshot.
resources.Original: 現在のレーサー情報がないため給餌をスキップできません。
resources.Translated: 由于缺乏当前的赛车手信息，无法跳过喂食。

resources.Key: The desired inherited ability is unavailable in current game data.
resources.Original: 希望する継承アビリティが現在のゲームデータにありません。
resources.Translated: 目前的游戏数据中没有您希望的继承能力。

resources.Key: The native Select Chocobo list entry is unavailable or disabled.
resources.Original: ネイティブのSelect Chocobo項目が使用不可か無効です。
resources.Translated: 原生 Select Chocobo 项目不可用或无效。

resources.Key: Scroll down to "The Dumpster Fire" channel to discuss issues / suggestions for specific plugins.
resources.Original: プラグインの問題や提案は「The Dumpster Fire」チャンネルでご相談ください。
resources.Translated: 请在 “The Dumpster Fire” 频道咨询插件问题和建议。

resources.Key: Exact shopping list for the current plan.
resources.Original: 現在の計画に必要な購入品一覧です。
resources.Translated: 这是当前计划所需的购买清单。

resources.Key: The observed Chocobo tab is not ready for its native button event.
resources.Original: 確認したチョコボタブのネイティブボタン処理が未準備です。
resources.Translated: 已确认的巧克力按钮的原生按钮处理尚未准备就绪。

resources.Key: Reserve stable and vendor automation seams.
resources.Original: 厩舎・商店自動化の連携部分を確保。
resources.Translated: 确保马厩和商店自动化的协同部分。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer window did not appear in time.
resources.Original: ゴールドソーサー画面が時間内に開きませんでした。
resources.Translated: 金源画面未能在规定时间内打开。

resources.Key: The observed retirement confirmation button is unavailable.
resources.Original: 確認した引退確認ボタンが使用できません。
resources.Translated: 确认的退出确认按钮无法使用。

resources.Key: Initial racing tutorial admitted; VERMAXION owns the race.
resources.Original: 初回レース練習の出走を受理。レースはVERMAXIONが管理します。
resources.Translated: 受理首次比赛练习的出发。比赛由 VERMAXION 管理。

resources.Key: The native gil-shop purchase could not be dispatched safely.
resources.Original: ギル商店の購入を安全に実行できませんでした。
resources.Translated: 无法安全地购买吉尔商店的商品。

resources.Key: Trainer feed inventory did not open after selecting the trainer menu entry.
resources.Original: トレーナーメニュー選択後に飼料の所持品画面が開きませんでした。
resources.Translated: 选择训练器菜单后，饲料的随身物品界面没有打开。

resources.Key: Collection was requested; proof consumption and one matching fledgling must be reconciled before another request.
resources.Original: 引き取り要求済み。再要求前に証明書消費と一致する子1羽を照合してください。
resources.Translated: 已申请领回。在重新申请之前，请核对一只与证书使用情况相符的幼鸟。

resources.Key: Load racing chocobo data first so the purchase plan can compare against sessions available.
resources.Original: 残り訓練回数と購入計画を比較するには、まずレーサー情報を読み込んでください。
resources.Translated: 要比较剩余训练次数和购买计划，请先读取赛车手信息。

resources.Original: 手動トレーニング・飼料購入

resources.Key: Inventory window disappeared before the trainer-feed context menu became visible.
resources.Original: 給餌メニューが表示される前に所持品画面が閉じました。
resources.Translated: 在显示饲料菜单之前，随身物品画面关闭了。

resources.Key: This log has reached Dalamud's 100 MiB limit. Logging may have stopped, so recent activity may be missing and this log may not help troubleshoot your current issue.
resources.Original: このログはDalamudの100 MiB上限に達しています。記録が停止し、最近の動作が含まれていない可能性があるため、現在の問題の調査に役立たない場合があります。
resources.Translated: 此日志已达到 Daramud 的 100 MiB 上限。由于记录可能已停止，并且可能不包含最近的操作，因此可能无法帮助调查当前问题。

resources.Key: Breeding supply is purchased, but the supplier interaction did not release; Resume to reconcile the retained item.
resources.Original: 交配物資は購入済みですが商店の操作が終わりません。再開して保持アイテムを照合してください。
resources.Translated: 交接物资已经购买，但商店的操作尚未结束。请重新开始并核对保管物品。

resources.Key: Collection requires the existing eligible covering, its retained-parent pedigree and exactly one Proof of Covering.
resources.Original: 引き取りには現在の引取可能な交配、保持親の血統、交配証明書1枚が必要です。
resources.Translated: 领取需要当前可领取的交配、保管亲本的血统以及一张交配证书。

resources.Key: Could not open '{0}' on Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Traderで「{0}」を開けませんでした。
resources.Translated: 在 Tack & Feed Trader 中没有打开 “{0}”。

resources.Key: Racing chocobo page detected; waiting for RaceChocoboManager data.
resources.Original: レーサーページを検出。RaceChocoboManager情報待ち。
resources.Translated: 检测到激光器页面。等待 RaceChocoboManager 信息。

resources.Key: Automation uses the session-capped plan and subtracts feed already on hand before buying.
resources.Original: 自動処理は残り訓練回数を上限とし、所持飼料を差し引いて購入します。
resources.Translated: 自动处理以剩余训练次数的上限为限，并扣除饲料费用后购买。

resources.Key: Target cycle paused at a safe boundary.
resources.Original: 目標サイクルを安全な区切りで一時停止しました。
resources.Translated: 目标循环已在安全区间内暂时停止。

resources.Key: No visible inventory window was found while opening the trainer-feed context menu.
resources.Original: 給餌メニューを開く際に所持品画面が見つかりませんでした。
resources.Translated: 打开饲料菜单时，我找不到随身携带的物品页面。

resources.Key: Covering wait has no valid eligibility evidence.
resources.Original: 交配待ちに有効な引取条件の証拠がありません。
resources.Translated: 没有证据表明有效的交配等待条件。

resources.Key: Raise this non-matching G9 offspring as the missing owned counterpart; retain matching outputs.
resources.Original: 不一致のG9の子を不足する自前の相手として育て、一致する子は保持してください。
resources.Translated: 请将不符合 G9 标准的孩子培养成自己不足的对象，并保留符合标准的孩子。

resources.Key: Commence window did not appear after selecting Feed.
resources.Original: 給餌選択後に開始画面が開きませんでした。
resources.Translated: 选择喂食后，开始界面没有打开。

resources.Key: Discard is permanent. G9 stock, covering proof and selected breeding inputs are protected.
resources.Original: 破棄は取り消せません。G9の在庫、交配証明書、選択済みの育成素材は保護されます。
resources.Translated: 弃用不可撤销。G9 的库存、分配证书和选定的培育材料将受到保护。

resources.Original: チョコボ情報は未読込です。

resources.Key: The active racer's sex is unavailable.
resources.Original: 現レーサーの性別が不明です。
resources.Translated: 目前赛车手的性别不明。

resources.Key: Breeding, character or stock changed; cleanup stopped.
resources.Original: 育成状態、キャラクター、または在庫が変わったため、整理を停止しました。
resources.Translated: 由于培养状态、角色或库存发生变化，我们停止了整理。

resources.Original: 希望する継承アビリティ

resources.Key: Could not path near Tack & Feed Trader. Move closer or check vnavmesh.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Traderへの経路を作れません。近づくかvnavmeshを確認してください。
resources.Translated: 无法创建通往 Tack & Feed Trader 的路径。请查看 vnavmesh 以了解详情。

resources.Original: メインウィンドウに透明度を表示
resources.Translated: 在主窗口中显示透明度

resources.Key: Review the selected stock before discarding.
resources.Original: 破棄する前に選択した在庫を確認してください。
resources.Translated: 在销毁之前，请检查您选择的库存。

resources.Original: ゴールドソーサー画面を開いています…

resources.Key: Start a new offspring batch only after the existing action, queue and covering have settled.
resources.Original: 現在の行動・待機列・交配が落ち着いてから新しい子のバッチを開始してください。
resources.Translated: 请在当前行动、待命队列和交配结束后，开始新的孩子批次。

resources.Key: Could not find Race Chocobo Trainer in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: チョコボスクウェアでRace Chocobo Trainerが見つかりません。
resources.Translated: 在巧克力棒广场找不到 Race Chocobo Trainer。

resources.Key: The retained covering parent changed before native selection.
resources.Original: ネイティブ選択前に保持していた交配親が変わりました。
resources.Translated: 原生选择之前保留的交配父母已经更换。

resources.Original: 条件一致の産駒は未登録で保管
resources.Translated: 符合条件的产驹尚未注册并保管

resources.Key: The selected registration form changed before opening its context menu.
resources.Original: コンテキストメニューを開く前に登録証が変わりました。
resources.Translated: 在打开上下文菜单之前，注册证已更改。
